item.title: Money-moving ops need idempotency_key checked first
item.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment/credit/invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `audit.events(...)` for a matching key and return the original record without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` entry (INC-204 double-refund incident).
